definitions.description: Fraction of retained M6 self-development/shipping runs whose terminal outcome is success.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Derive from each retained run terminal outcome; success iff outcome == "success".

definitions.description: Mean provider timeout events per retained M6 self-development/shipping run.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Sum retained per-run provider_timeouts and divide by retained run count.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean number of runner attempts per retained M6 self-development/shipping run.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Arithmetic mean of retained per-run runner_attempts.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean byte length of the first model request per retained M6 self-development/shipping run.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Arithmetic mean of retained per-run first_request_bytes.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean first-request byte length for retained M6 runs whose terminal outcome is success.
definitions.population: Retained M6 self-development/shipping runs with terminal outcome == "success".
definitions.collection_method: Filter retained runs to outcome == "success"; compute arithmetic mean of first_request_bytes.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean first-request byte length for retained M6 runs whose terminal outcome is not success.
definitions.population: Retained M6 self-development/shipping runs with terminal outcome != "success".
definitions.collection_method: Filter retained runs to outcome != "success"; compute arithmetic mean of first_request_bytes.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean elapsed wall-clock duration of retained M6 self-development/shipping runs.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Arithmetic mean of retained per-run wall_clock_s.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean elapsed wall-clock duration of retained M6 runs whose terminal outcome is success.
definitions.population: Retained M6 self-development/shipping runs with terminal outcome == "success".
definitions.collection_method: Filter retained runs to outcome == "success"; compute arithmetic mean of wall_clock_s.

definitions.description: Total count of repeated identical failure observations across retained M6 self-development/shipping runs.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.

definitions.description: Arithmetic mean provider-reported model tokens consumed per retained M6 self-development/shipping run.
definitions.population: All retained M6 self-development/shipping runs in the bound EvidenceSnapshot.
definitions.collection_method: Arithmetic mean of retained per-run reported_tokens.

definitions.description: Maximum first-request byte length among retained M6 runs whose terminal outcome is not success.
definitions.population: Retained M6 self-development/shipping runs with terminal outcome != "success".
definitions.collection_method: Filter retained runs to outcome != "success"; compute max(first_request_bytes).
